chunks: Surely with hardship there is ease.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Inna ma'a al-'isri yusra'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a guarantee of divine assistance for the Ahl al-Bayt and their followers during times of tribulation, linking the 'ease' to the eventual victory of Imam al-Mahdi (aj). It underscores the principle that hardship is not permanent but a precursor to relief, encouraging believers to maintain sabr (patience) with the certainty of divine support.
